title: What is known about 1RB0LB_1RC1LC_1LD1RE_---0LA_1RE0RF_1RA0LF
description: Proof status of the six-state BB(6) holdout 1RB0LB_1RC1LC_1LD1RE_---0LA_1RE0RF_1RA0LF.
intro: Nobody knows whether this six-state, two-symbol Turing machine halts when started on a blank tape: it is one of the holdouts left open by the bbchallenge project. This page lists what has been established about it, sorted by what each result rests on.
verdict: The question is open. Lean proves no halt in the first 10,000 steps by the kernel alone and in the first 107 with native_decide; the C simulator finds no halt in the first 109 steps.

claims.title: The halting configurations
claims.text: The machine stops exactly when it reads the symbol of a halting transition (D0); the generated statement covers every configuration.

claims.title: No halt in the first 10,000 steps
claims.text: The list simulator of the shared library, proved to agree with the machine's semantics, runs 10,000 steps from blank tape without a halt, evaluated by Lean's kernel.

claims.title: No halt in the first 10<sup>7</sup> steps
claims.text: The same run, evaluated by compiled code.

claims.title: No halt in the first 10<sup>9</sup> steps
claims.text: The C simulator tools/c/triage.c runs 109 steps without a halt; at the end 23,775 cells have been visited and 12,567 of them hold a 1.

claims.title: Growth shape: fixed/sqrt
claims.text: Left of the start, the visited part of the tape grows like the square root of the step count, the signature of a head sweeping back and forth across the whole tape and adding a cell or a few at the end of each sweep (a bouncer-like shape) (fitted exponent 0.525). Right of the start it stopped growing in the second half of the run (bounded so far, or growing so slowly that no record fell in the last half).

claims.title: Macro structure (observed)
claims.text: A left-growing bouncer: next to the left end a block (10101001)^n grows by about 50 copies per long cycle, behind it a long irregular but slowly changing stretch of 10-based words; this machine and its twin (E0 = 1LE or 1RE) behave alike.

claims.title: Size of the tape description (family screen)
claims.text: At the 6 records between 2.6·10<sup>8</sup> and 1.6·10<sup>10</sup> steps (first new leftmost or rightmost cell after each threshold 10<sup>6</sup>·4^k) the tape has 10,390 to 83,440 visited cells and compresses to 72 to 139 level-2 tokens (repeats of a word of at most 40 cells, then repeats of groups of such tokens).

claims.title: Proposed family: F11, defect gases and irregular zones
claims.text: At the left-end records the tape is 0^3 101 (01101010)^n followed by a zone written in the pairs 01 and 10. The block grows (n = 1,230 at 2.6·108 steps, 9,822 at 1.6·1010). The zone has 98, 139, 90 and 118 level-2 tokens at the left-end records at 2.6·108, 109, 4.1·109 and 1.6·1010 steps, so it did not grow on this screen. It does contain long waves: at 4.1·109 steps one 64-cell word is repeated 390 times inside it, at 1.6·1010 steps 69 times, which is why the count of cells outside short repeats swings between 177 and 12,699. On these numbers alone the machine fits F01 (two periodic blocks and about a hundred irregular tokens). It is put in F11 with its sister 1RB0LB_1RC1LC_1LD1RE_---0LA_1LE0RF_1RA0LF, whose zone of the same kind grows, because the zone is the engine and it is a word over two letters with no bound known. The two machines differ in one transition (E on 0) and their runs are different: nothing is claimed about one from the other. If a closed-set test is wanted, this is the one of the two to try.

claims.title: Does it halt from blank tape?
claims.text: Not known. The decider pipeline of bbchallenge left it open; no proof either way is recorded here yet.

explainer.lede: Nobody knows. Started on a blank tape, this Turing machine has run for 10<sup>9</sup> steps without stopping. This page runs the real machine in your browser, shows the shape of its run, and lists what is known, each result marked by what it rests on.

facts.text: No halt in the C simulator; 23,775 cells visited.
No halt, proved in Lean; the first 10,000 by the kernel alone.
The growth shape of the two sides of the tape (see below).

sections.heading: A growing block and its wake
html: Next to the left end the tape is a block (10101001)^n; behind it a long stretch made of the words 10, 01, 0110 and 1001 that changes only near its left end. The block grows by about 50 copies per long cycle of the head. This machine and its twin, which differs only in what state E does on a 0, behave alike.

This is read off long runs, not yet proved: the next step is to state these patterns as rules, prove them with tools/py/bbtools/symtm.py, and see whether the counters can ever reach the configuration that halts.

sections.heading: Which family it belongs to
html: The 22 machines of family F09 (“bouncers over lists of counters, not yet classified”) were screened in one way. The machine runs from blank tape for 2·1010 steps; each time the tape reaches a new cell after a threshold, the tape is compressed twice: first repeats of one word, then repeats of groups of words. If the tape is a few growing blocks and a bounded rest, the number of level-2 tokens stays bounded while the tape grows. Everything in this section is observed in one run. None of it is proved.
Proposed family: F11, defect gases and irregular zones (a growing block (01101010)^n and behind it a zone written in the pairs 01 and 10; borderline F01).

At the left-end records the tape is 0^3 101 (01101010)^n followed by a zone written in the pairs 01 and 10. The block grows (n = 1,230 at 2.6·108 steps, 9,822 at 1.6·1010). The zone has 98, 139, 90 and 118 level-2 tokens at the left-end records at 2.6·108, 109, 4.1·109 and 1.6·1010 steps, so it did not grow on this screen. It does contain long waves: at 4.1·109 steps one 64-cell word is repeated 390 times inside it, at 1.6·1010 steps 69 times, which is why the count of cells outside short repeats swings between 177 and 12,699.

On these numbers alone the machine fits F01 (two periodic blocks and about a hundred irregular tokens). It is put in F11 with its sister 1RB0LB_1RC1LC_1LD1RE_---0LA_1LE0RF_1RA0LF, whose zone of the same kind grows, because the zone is the engine and it is a word over two letters with no bound known. The two machines differ in one transition (E on 0) and their runs are different: nothing is claimed about one from the other. If a closed-set test is wanted, this is the one of the two to try.
Next step. The same reading of the zone as a binary word; in this machine also the life of one wave (the 64-cell word), from its birth to its end.

sections.heading: The shape of the run
html: Left of the start, the visited part of the tape grows like the square root of the step count, the signature of a head sweeping back and forth across the whole tape and adding a cell or a few at the end of each sweep (a bouncer-like shape) (fitted exponent 0.525). Right of the start it stopped growing in the second half of the run (bounded so far, or growing so slowly that no record fell in the last half).
After 109 steps the tape spans 23,775 cells (18,423 left of the start, 531 right), with a density of 1s of 0.529.
These are measurements of one bounded run, sorted by tools/py/bbtools/triage.py; the macro structure behind them is the next thing to find.

summary: A left-growing bouncer: next to the left end a block (10101001)^n grows by about 50 copies per long cycle, behind it a long irregular but slowly changing stretch of 10-based words; this machine and its twin (E0 = 1LE or 1RE) behave alike.
